scenes.narration: Most people think investing is always the grown-up move.
scenes.subtitle: Investing feels like the grown-up move.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm pencil-and-gouache editorial finance scene on off-white paper: a young adult standing at a quiet desk, looking at an investment app represented by abstract teal growth shapes, with coins and a small plant nearby. Thoughtful, aspirational, no readable text, no logos, no celebrity likeness.

scenes.narration: But if your money is sitting beside high-interest debt, the math changes fast.
scenes.subtitle: High-interest debt changes the math.
scenes.image_prompt: A split warm pencil-and-gouache finance illustration: on one side a small stack of cash, on the other a heavy red credit card bill and abstract warning marks, with a simple balance scale between them. No readable text or numbers, no people, clean composition.

scenes.narration: A credit card charging twenty percent does not wait politely while your investments try to catch up.
scenes.subtitle: A 20% card does not wait.
scenes.image_prompt: A dramatic but clean warm pencil-and-gouache scene: a red credit card casts a long shadow over a small teal investment plant trying to grow, with a calculator and abstract percentage symbols in the background. No readable text except no actual numbers inside the image, no logos.

scenes.narration: That is why the first win is not always buying something new. Sometimes it is stopping the leak.
scenes.subtitle: Sometimes the first win is stopping the leak.
scenes.image_prompt: A metaphorical warm pencil-and-gouache finance scene: coins dripping through a leaking bucket on a desk, with a hand placing a patch over the leak. Muted gold coins, teal repair patch, off-white paper texture, no readable text, no logos.

scenes.narration: Keep a small emergency buffer, then attack the expensive debt with focus.
scenes.subtitle: Buffer first. Expensive debt next.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm pencil-and-gouache editorial finance desk scene: a small emergency jar protected by a simple shield icon, then a clear path of abstract blocks leading toward a shrinking red debt pile. Calm, organized, beginner-friendly, no readable text or numbers, no people.

scenes.narration: Once that pressure is gone, investing is no longer fighting yesterday's bill.
scenes.subtitle: Then investing has room to work.
scenes.image_prompt: A hopeful warm pencil-and-gouache scene: old bills fading into the background while a clean teal investment path, coins, and a growing plant move into the light. Adult professional finance explainer tone, no readable text, no logos, no people.

scenes.narration: The smartest move is not the most exciting one. It is the one that gives your next dollar the most power.
scenes.subtitle: Put your next dollar where it has power.
scenes.image_prompt: A closing warm pencil-and-gouache finance illustration: one glowing muted-gold coin at a crossroads, one path toward a red debt chain breaking, the other toward a teal growing plant. Balanced, elegant, memorable, off-white paper texture, no readable text, no logos.
